How to connect a serial console

• Phone USB-C → an OTG adapter if your phone needs one → a USB console adapter → the Console port of the device.

• A USB-C console cable made for your device may connect directly, with no extra adapter.

• An RJ45 Console port is not Ethernet. The sockets look alike but carry different signals — do not plug a console cable into a LAN port, or the other way around.

• Choose the adapter and the pinout for your exact model; vendors differ.

• RS-232, TTL UART and RS-485 devices each need an adapter of the matching type and voltage. The wrong type or voltage can damage the device.
